mentions.name: eachmind
mentions.description: This project gives each AI agent its own private, individually shaped memory and defines a protocol for what gets selectively shared between agents, when, and how. The goal is for agents to develop genuine perspectives and for agent teams to develop collective intelligence.
mentions.problem: Memory and continuity for AI agents.
mentions.source_excerpt: For memory and continuity, I am working on eachmind. Eachmind gives each agent its own memory — privately encoded, individually shaped — while defining a protocol for what gets selectively shared, when, and how.
